sub_question: Identify, for each customer, the timestamp of their earliest purchase.
sub_sql:
SELECT c.customer_id,
       MIN(p.payment_date) AS first_purchase_timestamp
FROM customer c
JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id;

sub_question: Calculate, for each customer, the sum of all purchase amounts to obtain total lifetime sales.
sub_sql:
WITH first_purchase AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           MIN(p.payment_date) AS first_purchase_timestamp
    FROM customer c
    JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT fp.customer_id,
       SUM(p.amount) AS total_lifetime_sales
FROM first_purchase fp
JOIN payment p ON fp.customer_id = p.customer_id
GROUP BY fp.customer_id;

sub_question: Sum, for each customer, the purchase amounts that occur within exactly seven days after the earliest purchase timestamp.
sub_sql:
WITH first_purchase AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           MIN(p.payment_date) AS first_purchase_timestamp
    FROM customer c
    JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT fp.customer_id,
       SUM(p.amount) AS sum_7d
FROM first_purchase fp
JOIN payment p ON fp.customer_id = p.customer_id
WHERE p.payment_date >= fp.first_purchase_timestamp
  AND p.payment_date <= datetime(fp.first_purchase_timestamp, '+7 days')
GROUP BY fp.customer_id;

sub_question: Sum, for each customer, the purchase amounts that occur within exactly thirty days after the earliest purchase timestamp.
sub_sql:
WITH first_purchase AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           MIN(p.payment_date) AS first_purchase_timestamp
    FROM customer c
    JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT fp.customer_id,
       SUM(p.amount) AS sum_30d
FROM first_purchase fp
JOIN payment p ON fp.customer_id = p.customer_id
WHERE p.payment_date >= fp.first_purchase_timestamp
  AND p.payment_date <= datetime(fp.first_purchase_timestamp, '+30 days')
GROUP BY fp.customer_id;

sub_question: Derive, for each customer, the percentage of total lifetime sales represented by the seven‑day sum.
sub_sql:
WITH first_purchase AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           MIN(p.payment_date) AS first_purchase_timestamp
    FROM customer c
    JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
), customer_sales AS (
    SELECT fp.customer_id,
           SUM(p.amount) AS total_ltv,
           SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_date >= fp.first_purchase_timestamp
                    AND p.payment_date < datetime(fp.first_purchase_timestamp, '+7 days')
               THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS sum_7d
    FROM first_purchase fp
    JOIN payment p ON fp.customer_id = p.customer_id
    GROUP BY fp.customer_id
    HAVING total_ltv > 0
)
SELECT cs.customer_id,
       CAST(cs.sum_7d AS REAL) / cs.total_ltv * 100.0 AS percentage_7d
FROM customer_sales cs;
